source: Natural Earth v5.1.1 (public domain): 1:10m Rivers + Lake Centerlines (rivers of scalerank ≤ 7 that run along ≥ 30 % of a border) and 1:10m Geography Regions polygons (featurecla Range/mtn covering ≥ 30 % of a border); border ruggedness and elevation from NOAA ETOPO 2022 sampled along the shared pixels of the region-ID raster; named passes hand-listed in scripts/geo/handData.ts from Wikipedia/Britannica coordinates.
licence: Natural Earth: public domain. ETOPO 2022: public domain. Pass list: original compilation of public facts.
notes: One row per adjacent land-region pair that has a crossing feature. mountain = border ruggedness ≥ 120 m, or a named range along the border, or mean border elevation ≥ 3000 m. borderKm ≈ shared border length (raster pixels × 9.8 km). pass = a named pass on that border (the crossing is narrow but passable).

ranges: Southern Alps/Kā Tiritiri o te Moana
